name: How do I choose the best spot on my property for a tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best spot on my property for a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the best spot involves evaluating several factors: zoning setbacks, utility access points, sun exposure, natural drainage, privacy, and aesthetic appeal. Consider how the tiny home will integrate with existing structures and landscaping. A professional site assessment can help identify optimal locations by mapping out these elements, ensuring compliance, functionality, and maximizing the property's potential. Prioritize access to essential services and desirable views.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a tiny home spot by evaluating setbacks, utility access, sun exposure, drainage, privacy, and aesthetics. A site assessment helps find the optimal location.
